testCases.title: Verify Hotel Destination City Search and Auto-suggestion Selection
testCases.description: User searches for a valid city (e.g. New Delhi, Goa) and selects the auto-suggested option.
testCases.preconditions: User is on Hotel Search page (/compare-stay)
steps: Navigate to Hotel tab under Travel & Stays
Type destination city name into City search input
Wait for dropdown suggestions to appear
testCases.expectedResult: Selected city is populated into the destination field and suggestion list closes.

testCases.title: Verify Check-in and Check-out Date Selection from Calendar (15th - 16th October)
testCases.description: User opens the dual-month calendar and selects valid future dates (15th Oct Check-in, 16th Oct Check-out).
testCases.preconditions: Destination city is selected, calendar is visible
steps: Verify October 2026 month is visible or navigate forward
testCases.expectedResult: Check-in shows 15 Oct and Check-out shows 16 Oct in search bar.

testCases.title: Verify Room and Guest Configuration Selection
testCases.description: User configures valid number of rooms, adults, and child guests.
testCases.preconditions: User is on Hotel Search page
steps: Adjust adults (e.g. 2 adults) and rooms (1 room)
testCases.expectedResult: Guest summary updates to '2 Guests, 1 Room'.

testCases.title: Verify Hotel Search Results Displayed on Listing Page
testCases.description: Click 'Search' button and confirm hotel cards load with pricing, rating, and facilities.
testCases.preconditions: Search parameters (City, Dates, Guests) are filled
steps: Verify hotel results count and hotel cards display
testCases.expectedResult: Listing page shows available hotels with pricing and 'Book Now' buttons.

testCases.title: Verify Hotel Details Navigation & Book Now Trigger
testCases.description: Click 'Book Now' on any listed hotel card to open Hotel Details tab/page.
steps: Center target hotel card in viewport
Click 'Book Now' button on hotel card
Switch context if opened in new tab
testCases.expectedResult: Hotel details page loads showing hotel overview and room choices.

testCases.title: Verify Room Selection and Booking Proceed
testCases.description: Click 'Select Room' button and book an available room option.
steps: Click 'Select Room' button to scroll to room grid
Select room option (e.g. Deluxe Room / Standard)
testCases.expectedResult: Proceeds towards checkout or policy confirmation dialog.

testCases.title: Verify Cancellation Policy Modal and Continue Action
testCases.description: Handle cancellation policy dialog if displayed and click Continue.
testCases.expectedResult: Modal closes and user progresses to guest details / checkout page.

testCases.title: Verify Terms & Conditions Consent and Final Checkout
testCases.description: Scroll to bottom of checkout page, check mandatory consent box and proceed.
steps: Scroll to bottom of checkout page
Check mandatory Terms & Conditions consent checkbox
testCases.expectedResult: Consent is recorded and user advances to payment gateway.

testCases.title: Verify Validation when Searching with Empty Destination City
testCases.description: Click search button without entering any destination city.
testCases.preconditions: Hotel search page is open, city field is cleared
testCases.expectedResult: Search is prevented; validation message prompts user to select a city.

testCases.title: Verify Error Handling for Invalid / Non-existent Destination City
testCases.description: Enter gibberish / non-existent city name (e.g. 'XYZABC9999').
testCases.preconditions: User is on Hotel Search page
steps: Type non-existent text in city field
testCases.expectedResult: No suggestions found or 'No results' message shown; user cannot select invalid city.

testCases.title: Verify Past Dates are Disabled in Calendar
testCases.description: Verify calendar disables dates prior to current date so past booking is impossible.
steps: Inspect dates in calendar earlier than today (e.g. 1st September 2026)
Attempt to click disabled past date
testCases.expectedResult: Past dates have aria-disabled='true' and cannot be selected.

testCases.title: Verify Check-out Date cannot be Earlier than Check-in Date
testCases.description: Attempt to set check-out date prior to check-in date.
testCases.preconditions: Check-in date is selected as 15th October
steps: Attempt to select 10th October as check-out
testCases.expectedResult: Calendar prevents selection or resets check-in date to the earlier date.

testCases.title: Verify Error Handling when Hotel / Room becomes Unavailable
testCases.description: Handle supplier sold-out error banner on hotel details or booking page.
testCases.preconditions: Attempt to book a room that has 0 availability
steps: Detect availability error modal or banner
testCases.expectedResult: Application shows availability warning and allows rerunning with another hotel/room.

testCases.title: Verify Validation when Mandatory Consent Checkbox is Unchecked
testCases.description: Attempt to click Continue on Checkout without accepting Terms & Conditions.
testCases.preconditions: On Checkout page, consent checkbox is unchecked
testCases.expectedResult: Form validation prevents navigation; prompts user to accept Terms & Conditions.

testCases.title: Verify One-Way Flight Search with Valid Origin and Destination
testCases.description: Select One-Way radio, enter Origin (DEL) and Destination (BOM) airports.
steps: Enter origin city 'Delhi' and select 'DEL - Indira Gandhi Intl'
Enter destination city 'Mumbai' and select 'BOM - Chhatrapati Shivaji Intl'
testCases.expectedResult: Both sectors populate airport codes DEL and BOM accurately.

testCases.title: Verify Flight Departure Date Selection from Calendar
testCases.description: Select valid future departure date and dismiss any auto-opened return calendar.
steps: Ensure return calendar overlay is dismissed
testCases.expectedResult: Departure date is set and search button is clickable without overlay blocking.

testCases.title: Verify Passenger Count and Cabin Class Selection
testCases.description: Configure travelers (Adults, Children, Infants) and Cabin Class (Economy/Business).
steps: Set adults count to 1 and cabin class to Economy
testCases.expectedResult: Traveler summary reflects '1 Adult, Economy'.

testCases.title: Verify Flight Search Execution and Results Listing
testCases.description: Click Search Flights button and verify results are rendered on listing page.
testCases.preconditions: All flight search parameters are filled
steps: Wait for flight listing page navigation
Verify flight cards display with price, duration, and stops
testCases.expectedResult: Flight search results are rendered with available airlines (IndiGo, Air India, etc.).

testCases.title: Verify Flight Filtering by Stops and Airlines
testCases.description: Apply filter (e.g. Non-Stop only) and verify results reflect filter.
testCases.expectedResult: Only non-stop flights are shown in the listing results.

testCases.title: Verify Flight Fare Selection (Book Now)
testCases.description: Select fare option on first available flight card and proceed.
testCases.expectedResult: Navigates to flight review / itinerary page.

testCases.title: Verify Round-Trip Flight Search with Return Date
testCases.description: Select Round-Trip option and set valid departure and return dates.
steps: Select Return date after departure date
testCases.expectedResult: Search executes for both outbound and inbound flight journeys.

testCases.title: Verify Passenger Details Entry on Flight Itinerary Page
testCases.description: Enter valid primary passenger information (Title, First Name, Last Name, Email, Mobile).
steps: Fill Title, First Name, Last Name
Fill valid Email Address and Mobile Number
testCases.expectedResult: Passenger details accepted without validation errors.

testCases.title: Verify Validation when Origin and Destination are Identical
testCases.description: Select Delhi (DEL) as Origin and Delhi (DEL) as Destination.
steps: Attempt to select DEL as Destination airport
testCases.expectedResult: Validation error: Origin and destination cannot be identical; search blocked.

testCases.title: Verify Validation when Searching with Empty Origin or Destination
testCases.description: Leave destination blank and attempt to click Search Flights.
testCases.expectedResult: Validation error prompts user to select destination airport.

testCases.title: Verify Infant Count Cannot Exceed Adult Count
testCases.description: Attempt to configure 2 infants with only 1 adult passenger.
steps: Attempt to increase infants count to 2
testCases.expectedResult: UI restricts infant count to <= adult count or shows aviation regulatory warning.

testCases.title: Verify Past Dates Disabled for Flight Departure
testCases.description: Inspect departure calendar and verify dates earlier than today are disabled.
steps: Inspect cells prior to current date in calendar grid
testCases.expectedResult: Past dates have aria-disabled='true' and cannot be selected.

testCases.title: Verify Return Date cannot be Earlier than Departure Date
testCases.description: In Round-Trip mode, verify return date cannot precede departure date.
testCases.preconditions: Round Trip selected, departure date set
steps: Attempt to select return date prior to departure (e.g. 15th Oct)
testCases.expectedResult: Calendar disables dates earlier than departure or resets departure date.

testCases.title: Verify Validation for Malformed Traveler Email or Mobile
testCases.description: Enter invalid email ('abc@@xyz') or invalid mobile ('123') on traveler details form.
steps: Enter invalid email string into Email field
Enter less than 10 digits in Mobile number field
testCases.expectedResult: Inline validation messages show 'Enter valid email' and 'Enter valid 10-digit mobile'.
